name: invalid-padded-base64
notes: Padded base64 must be rejected rather than leniently accepted: accepting both spellings means the vectors no longer pin one encoding. Discriminating by construction (PQ-IOS-3): the decoded bytes are a valid sealed delta at an unused seq, so a decoder relaxed to accept padding decrypts and ACCEPTS this envelope -- the rejection is attributable to strict base64url alone. ciphertext_b64u is the canonical unpadded spelling of the same bytes; envelope_json.ciphertext is the padded wire spelling under test.
